```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyterra)
library(terra)
library(sf)
templateRaster <- rast("D:/Minnesota/templateRaster.tif")
```

# Mosaic MN together

```{r}
MN.shp <- st_read("C:/Users/lagoodal/Documents/TEST HPC OUTPUTS/MN_Shapefile/mn_county_boundaries.shp")
directory <- "D:/Minnesota/TreeMap"
files <- list.files(directory, full.names = TRUE)
fortypcdList <- list()
for (file in files) {
  raster <- rast(file)
  name <- basename(file)
  fortypcdList[[name]] <- raster
}

rasterSPRC <- sprc(fortypcdList)
fortypcdMN <- mosaic(rasterSPRC)


shapefile <- st_transform(MN.shp, crs = crs(fortypcdMN))
fortypcdMN <- crop(fortypcdMN, shapefile) %>% mask(., shapefile)
fortypcdMN <- ifel(fortypcdMN < 0, 0, fortypcdMN)
fortypcdMN <- project(fortypcdMN, templateRaster, method = "near")

plot(fortypcdMN)


writeRaster(fortypcdMN,
            filename = "D:/Minnesota/Data/IC_30m_UTM15N.tif",
            overwrite = TRUE,
            datatype = "INT4S",
            NAflag = 0)


fortypcdDf <- read_csv("D:/Minnesota/FORTYPCDs.csv")[,-1] %>% `colnames<-`(c("FORTYPCD", "Forest_Type")) %>%
  mutate(FORTYPCD = str_trim(FORTYPCD, side = "both"))
fortypcdDf$FORTYPCD <- as.integer(fortypcdDf$FORTYPCD)

# Plot with labels and not just the numbered FORTYPCDs
r < fortypcdMN
r <- as.int(r)
r <- as.factor(r)
levels(r) <- fortypcdDf
plot(r)

```


```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load template raster
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
templateRaster <- rast("D:/Minnesota/templateRaster.tif")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load MN county boundary
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
MN.shp <- st_read(
  "C:/Users/lagoodal/Documents/TEST HPC OUTPUTS/MN_Shapefile/mn_county_boundaries.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load and mosaic all forest type rasters
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
directory <- "D:/Minnesota/TreeMap"
files <- list.files(directory, full.names = TRUE)

rasterSPRC <- sprc(files)
fortypcdMN <- mosaic(rasterSPRC)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reproject & crop to Minnesota
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
MN.shp <- st_transform(MN.shp, crs(fortypcdMN))

fortypcdMN <- crop(fortypcdMN, MN.shp)
fortypcdMN <- mask(fortypcdMN, MN.shp)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean invalid values
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
fortypcdMN <- ifel(fortypcdMN < 0, NA, fortypcdMN)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Align to template raster
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
fortypcdMN <- project(
  fortypcdMN,
  templateRaster,
  method = "near"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert to categorical raster
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
fortypcdMN <- as.int(fortypcdMN)
fortypcdMN <- as.factor(fortypcdMN)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load forest type lookup table
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
fortypcdDf <- read_csv(
  "D:/Minnesota/FORTYPCDs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  select(`Forest type / type group`) |>
  mutate(
    FORTYPCD = as.integer(str_trim(`Forest type / type group`))
  )


read_csv(
  "D:/Minnesota/FORTYPCDs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Attach labels to raster (RAT)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
levels(fortypcdMN) <- fortypcdDf

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Write output raster
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
writeRaster(
  fortypcdMN,
  "D:/Minnesota/Data/IC_MN.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot for sanity check
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
plot(fortypcdMN)



```
